run_eft_step: run a single EFT training step on an input batch to refine SMPL pose and shape predictions
run_eft_step_with_2dhand: run an EFT training step that incorporates 2D hand keypoint supervision alongside body keypoints
run_eft_step_wHand: run an EFT training step with 3D hand joint loss for SMPL-X hand refinement
run_smplify: run SMPLify optimization on a batch to refine SMPL parameters using 2D keypoint reprojection
eftAllInDB: run EFT fine-tuning on all samples in the training database and export results as pickle files
